description: Repairs the registration pages of a webinar: it decodes content that was saved double-encoded, and replaces the placeholder webinar id that pages copied from another campaign still carry, so the page shows THIS webinar's form and date. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Participants see a working page again where one was broken; nothing else on the campaign changes. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. Use it when the host says a page shows a wrong date, an empty form or raw characters. This is the repair for a broken page, not the way to change a text (that is wi_change_webinar_text).

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_repair_webinar_pages
title: Repair a webinar's broken pages
